plain_statement: G is the graph on vertices 0 to 10 with edges 0-9, 0-10, 1-4, 1-8, 2-5, 2-10, 3-6, 3-7, 4-8, 4-10, 5-8, 5-9, 6-7, 6-10, 7-9, 8-9; F is true exactly when both ends of an edge are true. Gates: AND, OR, each reading exactly two earlier wires, no constants, all counted. Top form: no AND gate implying F lies in the cone of an AND gate; a junk AND is true somewhere F is false. Every least top-form circuit computing F (no smaller such circuit computes F) with at least two junk ANDs has at least 22 gates. Conjecture.
title: The 11-vertex graph G11 (no 4-cycle, cover number 7): least top-form fan-in-exactly-two AND/OR circuits with 2+ junk ANDs have at least 22 gates
